name: cosmos-stockdata-tools
description: Run and incrementally grow per-user China stock-data scripts with a generic SuperMind runtime.

interface.shortDescription: Run and grow durable per-user stock-data scripts.
interface.longDescription: Bundles a generic SuperMind runtime and contract-neutral implementation references while each user accumulates reusable China stock-data business scripts in a durable external workspace as requirements arrive; plugin or marketplace updates do not own that workspace. Per-user workspace, token-file path, and micromamba environment bindings stay outside the plugin. Each extension preserves existing behavior and follows the source priority SuperMind, then baostock, then AKShare, with explicit provenance and contract-specific validation.
defaultPrompt: Create the first stock-data script in my durable external workspace, starting with SuperMind.
Extend my existing stockdata workspace with another requested dataset.
Run a capability already accumulated in my stockdata workspace.
